headline: Which Decile 9-10 Households Will No Longer Be Allowed to Buy Pertalite? Here Are the Criteria
summary: Criteria have been outlined for households in deciles 9 and 10 that could no longer be allowed to buy subsidized Pertalite fuel, which the government is restricting to target subsidies.
why: Pertalite is a subsidized gasoline grade in Indonesia, and changes to eligibility affect fuel demand and government subsidy spending.
